profile_text.body:
Modular is a for-profit startup founded in 2022 and headquartered in Los Altos, California. Its site describes a unified AI inference stack that runs from custom GPU kernels to production cloud serving on NVIDIA and AMD hardware. The company calls the stack open source and states "2x performance," and it presents the MAX Platform and the Mojo language as its main tools.

Per the site, MAX runs 1000+ models out of the box, including DeepSeek and Kimi, with PyTorch-like model APIs meant to make porting custom models quick. The same model and codebase are said to run across NVIDIA, AMD, Trainium, TPU, Qualcomm, Intel, ARM, and Apple silicon, either in Modular's hosted cloud or a customer VPC. The site argues that most AI infrastructure is assembled from parts that were never designed to work together, and it offers one stack for heterogeneous compute as the alternative. It quotes a testimonial about bringing GenAI innovations to market faster for AWS customers, and it lists leaders with backgrounds at Apple, Google, NVIDIA, SiFive, Tesla, and the LLVM Foundation, including work on LLVM, Clang, MLIR, TensorFlow, XLA, JAX, cuDNN, and CUTLASS.

No lawsuits involving Modular are recorded.
